question: A man buys 9 identical articles for a total of ₹16. If he sells each of them for ₹2.8, then his profit percentage will be ______%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Cost Price (CP) for 9 articles = ₹16

Total Selling Price (SP) for 9 articles = 9 × 2.8 = ₹25.2

Profit = 25.2 − 16 = ₹9.2

Profit % = (9.2 ÷ 16) × 100 = 57.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 57.5%.**
